section.heading: FR-2 Transfer limit
section.text:
The system shall reject a transfer whose amount, converted to QAR, exceeds the customer's daily limit.
The customer sees error 003041. The daily limit for international transfers is QAR 50,000, the same as the daily limit
for local transfers.

cards.text: An international transfer is rejected with error 003041 when its amount, converted to QAR, exceeds the customer's daily limit.
The daily limit for international transfers is QAR 50,000.
The daily limit for international transfers is the same as the daily limit for local transfers.
